name: 카밀로
motion_summary: Eternal Return Camilo Duende: stylish pale blond-white hair with long bangs, red eyes, elegant black suit and open collar, TWO slender swords as exact reference. R is a dancer's forward-and-return dash; dance ends in a strike, not a stationary spin attack. 12 sequential poses: elegant ready with two swords down; raise one sword and bend knee; extend opposite arm and point leading foot; dance glide forward-right with coat and hair flowing; turn hips and sweep first blade; pivot on toe and torso rotates; reverse dance glide toward original position; crossed swords flourish; end with decisive outward double-blade sweep and gold-white arc; bow slightly with swords extended; straighten and lower blades; elegant ready. Distinct dancer footwork and whole-body rotation clear, both eyes and tiny confident smile visible except intentional profile. Keep feet/camera origin consistent, lateral movement is intentional. No rose garden or extra dance partner. Landscape4:3, 4×3 equal square cells, generous transparent margins and contained sword arcs.
visual_review: 붉은 눈·흰 머리·검은 정장과 쌍검이 유지됩니다. 전진 검무, 발끝 회전, 복귀와 마지막 타격이 분리됩니다.
